title: Eval Dataset Row
description: JSONL format for instruction datasets. Each line is one SFT row: a prompt and the response the model should give. Datasets are uploaded, validated and reviewed here; an imported adapter is scored against a held-out set of such rows by the eval gate.

prompt.description: The instruction or question given to the model.

response.description: The ideal response the model should produce.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata (source, quality score, etc.)
